packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the CDM process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events of the CDM process, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: AirportCdmPartner
classes.definition: A generic party involved in the Airport CDM process that originates or receives flight information and is informed of milestone events.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifying name of the partner.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The partner's role in the CDM process.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or operator that submits the ATC flight plan, provides TOBT and turn-round information, and manages the aircraft's turn-round.

operations.name: submitAtcFlightPlan
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan is submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS (M1).

operations.name: provideTobt
operations.description: The Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides the most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation, integrating their own strategy (M9).

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party that manages ground handling operations for the flight and coordinates with the Aircraft Operator on TOBT and turn-round.

classes.name: AirTrafficControl
classes.definition: The air traffic control unit (including Area Control Centre/Approach Control Unit and Tower) that issues TSAT, TWR instructions, and start-up approvals, and detects flights via radar/A-SMGCS/FDPS.

attributes.name: unitType
attributes.description: The type of ATC unit, e.g. Area Control Centre, Approach Control Unit, Tower.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, distributes flight plans, monitors flight progress via ETFMS, and receives DPI/FUM messages.

operations.name: issueCtot
operations.description: The CTOT is issued by Network Operations at EOBT-2 hr if the flight is regulated (M2).

classes.name: StandGateManagement
classes.definition: The party responsible for stand and gate allocation decisions that depend on accurate ELDT and EIBT.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single flight (arrival or departure) that is tracked through the CDM milestones with its operational status and time quantities.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether the flight is an arrival or a departure.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight, changed at each milestone (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, LANDED, IN-BLOCK, SEQUENCED, BOARDING, READY, OFF-BLOCK, DEPARTED/TAKE OFF).

attributes.name: isRegulated
attributes.description: Marked REGULATED at EOBT-2 hr if the flight receives a CTOT from Network Operations (M2).

attributes.name: timeQuantities
attributes.description: The successive scheduled, estimated, target, actual, and calculated time values recorded for this flight.

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round comprising a related arriving and departing flight, described by a defined turn-round period.

attributes.name: mttt
attributes.description: The defined/estimated minimum turn-round time period used to calculate TOBT/TTOT for the departing flight (M6, M7, M8).

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, identified by registration and type.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration, which the flight plan may be used to update (M1).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of aircraft, which the flight plan may be used to update (M1).

classes.name: AtcFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan submitted to ATC for a flight, distributed by the IFPS, and checked for consistency with the airport slot and flight data.

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated Off-Block Time on the flight plan.

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL, used with ATOT to calculate ELDT (M3).

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: ADEP, the departure aerodrome.

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: The destination aerodrome.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether the submission is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (M1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry that the ATC Flight Plan must correspond to, used to initiate the outbound flight at coordinated airports.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: Scheduled Off-Block Time from the airport slot, fed with the SOBT as early as possible for consistent DPI messaging (M1).

attributes.name: slotProgramme
attributes.description: The airport slot programme the flight plan must correspond to.

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A single dated value of a named time quantity (identified by prefix and event) for a flight, recorded with its originator, accuracy and update time; every successive value is kept rather than overwritten.

attributes.name: prefixType
attributes.description: The prefix of the time quantity: Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, or Calculated.

attributes.name: eventType
attributes.description: The event the time quantity relates to, e.g. Off-Block, In-Block, Landing, Take-Off, Start-Up Approval.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The time value itself.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: Who or what provided/updated this value (e.g. ATC, ACARS, AO/GH, Airport CDM Platform).

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: Stated accuracy, e.g. +/- 1 minute for actual times (M3,6,7,8,11,12,13,14,15,16).

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: Agreed tolerance before a change must be notified, e.g. 5 minute TTOT tolerance before take off from outstation (M3), or locally agreed TSAT tolerance (M13,14).

attributes.name: recordedAt
attributes.description: Time at which this value was appended/recorded.

operations.name: update
operations.description: Appends a new successive value for this time quantity rather than overwriting the previous one, so the turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

operations.name: calculateEldtFromAtot
operations.description: Using the ATOT, ELDT is calculated using the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL (M3).

operations.name: calculateEibt
operations.description: EIBT is computed using the ELDT/ALDT and the estimated taxi-in time (EXIT) (M4, M6).

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculation basis for TTOT takes into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT; if TOBT is manually input it overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (M2, M3).

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceExceeded
operations.description: Checks whether TTOT has changed by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance, in which case Network Operations must be informed (M4-M10, M15).

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: A superclass for the sixteen CDM milestone events, each with a definition, timing rule, trigger, effect, and procedure that changes the flight's operational status.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: The number of the milestone (1-16).

attributes.name: definition
attributes.description: The document's definition of the milestone event.

attributes.name: timingRule
attributes.description: The timing rule stated by the document for when the milestone occurs.

attributes.name: dataQuality
attributes.description: The stated data quality/accuracy for information at this milestone.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: What the document states triggers this milestone's process.

attributes.name: operationalStatusChange
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to at this milestone.

classes.name: AtcFlightPlanActivated
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ICAO flight plan is submitted to ATC and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: sendFirstEdpi
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations via the first E-DPI message with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data; not sent if information is missing or inconsistent.

operations.name: updateEldtEibtEtot
operations.description: ELDT and EIBT updated for an arrival; EOBT and ETOT updated for a departure.

classes.name: Eobt2hrCheck
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2 hr regulated flights receive a CTOT and estimates are checked against the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkFlightEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan to verify feasibility of the estimated off-block time at EOBT-2 hr.

operations.name: sendTDpi
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about the updated take off time estimate using a T-DPI message at EOBT-2 hrs.

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED when the flight receives a CTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP) is recorded and used to update ELDT and downstream estimates.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH estimated landing time after take off from outstation is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: sendTDpiT
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about the updated take off time estimate using a T-DPI-t message; a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected first.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport, triggering a TOBT/ELDT update.

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase, prompting a further TOBT/ELDT update, typically 2 to 5 minutes from landing.

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT, the actual landing time, triggers an update of downstream TOBT, TTOT and EIBT estimates.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT/ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: updateEibtFromAldt
operations.description: EIBT can be updated according to ALDT+EXIT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotExceedsTolerance
operations.description: A TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: InBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT, the actual in-block time, triggers an update of downstream TOBT and TTOT estimates.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: updateTobtTtotFromTurnround
operations.description: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or manually, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: Milestone 8: ACGT, the commencement of ground handling operations, triggers an update of TOBT for flights first of the day or long-parked.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: updateTobtFromTurnround
operations.description: TOBT is updated automatically or manually, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: FinalConfirmationOfTobt
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the time at which the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides its most accurate TOBT, t minutes before EOBT.

operations.name: confirmTobt
operations.description: Checks TOBT quality at a predefined local time before TSAT issue, triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update; no need to reconfirm if manually modified before.

operations.name: calculateExot
operations.description: Following receipt of TOBT, the ATC system calculates and provides the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the holding position.

classes.name: TsatIssued
classes.definition: Milestone 10: ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time, stabilising the flight into the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: issueTsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight; Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTobtUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates exceeds a locally defined tolerance after TSAT has been issued; if exceeded the TOBT input is processed per local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate is opened for passengers to physically start boarding.

operations.name: recordAsbt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a locally defined time before TOBT, checks the boarding status and informs the AO/GH if TOBT needs updating.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: Milestone 12: all doors closed, boarding bridge removed, push back vehicle connected; the aircraft is ready to taxi (ARDT).

operations.name: recordArdt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Ready Time (ARDT) in the Airport CDM Platform, confirming the aircraft is ready for start up/push-back.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT+tolerance, informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed and no ARDT or Ready Status (RDY) has been received.

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: Milestone 13: the time that start up is requested by the pilot via ATC (ASRT).

operations.name: recordAsrt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start-up Request Time (ASRT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkStartUpRequestedWithinTolerance
operations.description: Alerts all relevant partners when no start up has been requested inside the locally agreed TSAT tolerance window; if not made by TSAT+tolerance, AO/GH is informed and should update TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ATC grants start up approval to the aircraft (ASAT).

operations.name: recordAsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start-up Approval Time (ASAT), confirming the aircraft has received start up approval/push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkAsatAgainstTsat
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT; if start up approval is not granted at TSAT+tolerance, all relevant partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the time the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

operations.name: recordAobt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT), confirming push-back/taxi has commenced.

operations.name: sendADpi
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or at a defined time prior to TTOT in case of remote holding.

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndInform
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed with a new A-DPI of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the actual take off time, ending the departure sequence for the flight.

operations.name: recordAtot
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off, triggered by Tower FDPS, A-SMGCS/Radar detection or ACARS.

operations.name: sendFsaAndMvtMessages
operations.description: FSA and MVT messages are sent on take off.

operations.name: removeFromDepartureSequence
operations.description: An airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

classes.name: AirportCdmPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform system that is initiated per flight, processes available information, computes and records time quantities, marks status fields, and informs Airport CDM Partners at each milestone.

operations.name: initiateForFlight
operations.description: Initiated for the flight and processes all available information (M1).

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED for a flight that receives a CTOT (M2).

operations.name: calculateTobtAutomatically
operations.description: A new TOBT can be calculated automatically by the Airport CDM Platform following an ELDT update (M4).

operations.name: informPartners
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of an actual time event (ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT, AOBT, ATOT) as it occurs (M11-16).

classes.name: AtcSystem
classes.definition: The ATC technical system(s) (radar, A-SMGCS, Tower FDPS) that detect flight events and provide time quantities such as ATOT, ALDT and TSAT.

classes.name: Acars
classes.definition: The ACARS system aboard equipped aircraft that provides actual time events (ON, IN, OUT, OFF) such as ALDT, AIBT, AOBT and ATOT.

classes.name: Ifps
classes.definition: The system that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

classes.name: EtfmsSystem
classes.definition: The system used by Network Operations to monitor flight progress and issue Flight Update Messages.

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message sent by the Airport CDM Platform to Network Operations to communicate flight time estimates.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of DPI message: E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the message was sent.

classes.name: FumMessage
classes.definition: A Flight Update Message sent by Network Operations providing updates of a flight's progress used to update ELDT.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the message was sent.

classes.name: FsaMessage
classes.definition: An airborne/FSA message sent on take off.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the message was sent.

classes.name: MvtMessage
classes.definition: A movement (MVT) message sent on take off.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the message was sent.

unmodelled: The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT, which does not correspond to a discrete class or operation (M1).
For long distance flights the ELDT may differ from the airport slot, a nuance not captured as a distinct rule owner (M1).

The objective to decrease the number of stand and gate changes in the last 30 minutes, requiring high accuracy of departure and arrival times, is a guidance statement rather than an operation with a clear owner (M4).

ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT for a normal turn-round, but is a separate milestone for the first operation of the day or long-parked aircraft; this conditional equivalence is not separately modelled (M7, M8).

The locally agreed parameter t (minutes before EOBT) and other local parameters (thresholds, tolerances) are referenced as configurable values rather than modelled as their own class (M9, M10, M11, M12, M13, M14).
